content:
**Team Medic** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Your stimpaks now also heal your teammates.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your stimpaks now also heal nearby teammates for their full strength. | 00382A56 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your stimpaks now also heal nearby teammates for 75% of normal strength. | 00382A55 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your stimpaks now also heal nearby teammates for half the normal strength. | 00382A4D | 

This perk only gives the player a chance to heal a teammate, the effect activating is not guaranteed.
